
## Usage

```{r setup}
library(metaboapp)
exdata_path <- list.files(
  system.file(package = "metaboapp", "extdata"),
  "example_data.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```


## Load and clean data

`ReadFile()` expects a wide-format dataset where the rows are samples and
columns are metabolites.

```{r}
read.csv(exdata_path)[1:10, 1:5]
```

The `Sample` column should be in the form
`SampleID_Subgroup1ID-Subgroup2ID_BatchNo` to infer Sample, Group, Subgroup, and
Batch identifiers based on the "_" and "-" delimiters. The Metabolite column
must be in the form `MetaboliteName_ExtractionMethod` for filtering based on
extraction method (IP/HILIC/T3Acidic).

```{r}
(mdata <- ReadFile(exdata_path))
```

`ReadFile()` pivots the data from wide to long or tidy form for the rest of the
analysis.

## QC

Each metabolite in the dataset may be sampled with multiple extraction methods.
For each metabolite, `FilterExtraction()` selects the method with the fewest NAs
or the lowest variation. `FilterBlanks()` runs blank filtering to remove
metabolites from non-blank samples that fail to meet a specified fold-change
threshold compared to the same metabolites from blank samples. To identify the
data that get blank filtered without running the filtering, use
`GetBlankDropTable()` which `FilterBlanks()` uses to identify the metabolites to
remove as well as the blank samples.

`QCData` is a top-level function that calls both `FilterExtraction()` and
`FilterBlanks()`, and removes metabolites with low variance. 

```{r}
to_drop <- GetBlankDropTable(mdata)
head(to_drop$dropTable)
to_drop$blanks

qc_data <- QCData(mdata)
```

`RemoveMissing()` drops metabolites with more NAs than a specified proportion.
To just get those that would be removed, use `IdentifyMetabolites()`. Use
`PlotMissingness` to get a presence/absence heatmap of your data.

```{r}
head(IdentifyMissing(qc_data))
rm_data <- RemoveMissing(qc_data)
```

To examine your data before and after QC, you can use PCA:

```{r fig.ncol = 3}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
PlotPCA(GetPCA(mdata)) + ggtitle("Raw")
PlotPCA(GetPCA(qc_data))+ ggtitle("QC")
PlotPCA(GetPCA(rm_data))+ ggtitle("Missingness removed")
```

## Imputation

```{r}
imputed_data <- impute.QRILC(rm_data)
```

## Model fitting

```{r}
groups <- unique(imputed_data$Group)

results <- DiffMetabolites(imputed_data)

PlotVolcano(results, groups[c(1, 5)], contrastTitle = "Example")
PlotAllVolcanoes(results, groups[c(1:3)], contrastTitle = "Example") |>
  wrap_plots()
```

## Pipeline

```r
fc_data <- ReadFile(exdata_path) |>
  QCData() |>
  RemoveMissing() |>
  impute.QRILC() |>
  DiffMetabolites(groups = groups[1:2])
```
